label: TP
reason: User input from getParameterValues flows directly to response.getWriter().printf() without effective sanitization. The doSomething() method attempts to sanitize via StringBuilder.replace() but the condition 'param.length() - "Z".length()' evaluates to 0 (since Z.length()=1), making the replace operation ineffective. The X-XSS-Protection header is explicitly disabled (set to 0), confirming no protective measure.

evidence.note: User input captured from request.getParameterValues and passed through doSomething() then written to response.getWriter()
